WITH customer_total_return_unfiltered AS (
    SELECT
        wr.wr_returning_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk,
        ca.ca_state AS ctr_state,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS ctr_total_return
    FROM web_returns wr
    INNER JOIN date_dim dd ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
    INNER JOIN customer_address ca ON wr.wr_returning_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    WHERE dd.d_year = 2000
    GROUP BY wr.wr_returning_customer_sk, ca.ca_state
),
avg_return AS (
    SELECT
        u.ctr_state,
        AVG(u.ctr_total_return) * 1.2 AS avg_total
    FROM customer_total_return_unfiltered u
    GROUP BY u.ctr_state
),
customer_total_return AS (
    SELECT
        u.ctr_customer_sk,
        u.ctr_state,
        u.ctr_total_return
    FROM customer_total_return_unfiltered u
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM customer c
        INNER JOIN customer_address ca ON ca.ca_address_sk = c.c_current_addr_sk
        WHERE ca.ca_state = 'AR'
          AND c.c_customer_sk = u.ctr_customer_sk
    )
)
SELECT
    c.c_customer_id,
    c.c_salutation,
    c.c_first_name,
    c.c_last_name,
    c.c_preferred_cust_flag,
    c.c_birth_day,
    c.c_birth_month,
    c.c_birth_year,
    c.c_birth_country,
    c.c_login,
    c.c_email_address,
    c.c_last_review_date_sk,
    ctr1.ctr_total_return
FROM customer_total_return ctr1
INNER JOIN avg_return ar ON ctr1.ctr_state = ar.ctr_state
INNER JOIN customer c ON c.c_customer_sk = ctr1.ctr_customer_sk
INNER JOIN customer_address ca ON ca.ca_address_sk = c.c_current_addr_sk
    AND ca.ca_state = 'AR'
WHERE ctr1.ctr_total_return > ar.avg_total
ORDER BY
    c.c_customer_id,
    c.c_salutation,
    c.c_first_name,
    c.c_last_name,
    c.c_preferred_cust_flag,
    c.c_birth_day,
    c.c_birth_month,
    c.c_birth_year,
    c.c_birth_country,
    c.c_login,
    c.c_email_address,
    c.c_last_review_date_sk,
    ctr1.ctr_total_return
LIMIT 100
